## Release — backlog-campaign v0.19.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.19.0

Minor release centred on **durable campaign artifacts**, **hooks that fail closed**,
and **review codes that actually fire**. Plans and reviews no longer assume a PR
branch exists at thinking time; PreToolUse guards refuse unpushed worktree removal
and uncaught validator crashes; overloaded V-codes are split so BLOCK means BLOCK.

#### Durable artifact staging (ADR-021)

- **Unconditional promotion** — plan and review artifacts promote through a staging
  manifest, instead of being committed inside a PR that does not yet exist at
  thinking time.
- **Companion-file auto-repair** — implementers sync INDEX rows when documentation
  lands (`V-ADA`).
- **Reviewer §27** — Doc-Governance Judgment Audit covers Scope-2 citations so
  stale claims cannot merge as present-tense protocol.

#### Hooks fail closed

- **Worktree-removal guard** — `git worktree remove` is refused when the worktree
  still holds unpushed commits; trailing shell redirects are parsed so the check
  cannot be skipped by `2>&1`.
- **Validator crash path** — uncaught exceptions fail closed; fail-open ingest of
  PreToolUse events is recorded as `V-HOOK-03` rather than swallowed.
- **Write/Edit containment** — file mutations are narrowed to the assigned
  worktree; bash masking is heredoc-aware so quoted bodies are not false-denied.
- **Attack-signature layer** — diff-scoped security review has a reference catalog
  instead of relying on reviewer memory alone.

#### Review, V-codes, and filing

- `V-ADA-01` and `V-AUTO-02` raised to **BLOCK**, with a Staged Artifact Carry Audit.
- `V-SOLID-02` / `V-SOLID-04` / `V-SOLID-05` close the remaining OCP / ISP / DIP gap;
  `V-TEST-10` covers the Test Integrity Audit.
- Comment-discipline codes `V-DOC-05` / `V-DOC-06` / `V-DOC-07`; independent
  security verification spawn for `V-SEC-07`.
- **ADR-024** splits `V-PARETO-02` (discovery label) from `V-PARETO-03` (filing gate)
  so a BLOCK severity that never fired is no longer documented fiction.
- Campaign-audit gains `F-STALECITE-01` (stale issue citations) and `F-PARITY-01`
  (forge/queue drift).

#### Orchestration

- **Rebase & conflict preflight (ADR-023)** — squash-merge no longer dumps a
  conflicting PR into the generic Permanent skip path; the pipeline rebases first
  and surfaces hunks when it cannot.
- **`stop --now`** — workers cooperate on a live drain instead of being truncated
  mid-unit.
- **CI failure diagnosis** — protocol plus helper script, with `--repo` on the
  `gh run view` fallback so diagnosis works outside a git checkout.
- Reasoning effort is folded into the model-routing tier ladders.
- Planner reformulation async veto; advisory Touch-Paths SSOT gap heuristic.
- Campaign-specific `config.json` keys are registered in the template (`V-CONFIG-02`).

#### Kaizen

- **`backlog` hunt kind (ADR-022)** — scans scoped open issues for duplicate
  overlap, stale referents, and thin bodies. Inert unless the campaign opts into
  `kaizen`.
